issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מְיָֽרְאִ֤ים אוֹתָ֨נוּ֙' means 'they are frightening us' (they are intimidating us), but the Chinese says '他們都害怕我們' which means 'they are all afraid of us' — the subject/object of the fear is reversed. The Hebrew has them fearing us (making us afraid), not them being afraid of us.
